gaps.sentence: I ran ___ my old teacher at the airport.
gaps.explanation: run into somebody = meet them by chance (also: bump into).

gaps.sentence: The match was called ___ because of the storm.
We need to iron ___ a few details before signing.
Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: They live ___ their pension and a small rent.
gaps.explanation: live off = have as income/food; live on = have as income (money).

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
Don't ___ up all the milk — we need some for breakfast.
gaps.explanation: use up = finish the whole supply of something.
